Strategy generation

Local Ollama generation normally takes several minutes on this Mac and may take longer under load. Keep this form tab open after selecting Generate strategy.

No run ID exists until generation finishes. If the temporary form expires or closes before the next page displays a run ID, return to n8n, select Execute workflow, and start one new synthetic run. Do not repeatedly resubmit while the spinner is active.

After generation, the next page displays the stored run ID before the separate quality-review call begins.

parameters.content:
## AI Strategy Factory v0.1 — Stage 9.5-lite
Choose synthetic example, blank manual form, or size-limited JSON upload → validate and normalize → generation-readiness guidance → strategy draft → stored run-ID checkpoint → advisory quality report → explicit human review → approved Markdown artifact.

The two deliberate readiness pages separate the slow Ollama generation and critic calls, set timing expectations, and provide recovery guidance. Run status can be checked with `scripts/strategy-run-status.sh <run-id>`.

Uploads are limited to 64 KiB, unknown fields are rejected, and filenames are never used for artifact paths. The quality report cannot approve, reject, or rewrite a draft.

This workflow must remain inactive until separately approved for activation.
